lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 8-10 visible vertical columns of large, high-luminance circular spots. Within each column, 3-5 primary spots are visible above the midline, showing a roughly rectangular grid arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical white bands intersect with the lateral spots. These bands are approximately equidistant and serve as the vertical axis for the primary spot grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper half of the lateral flank, characterized by a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 10-15 smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily towards the anterior and central portions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of approximately 10-15 remoras is visible trailing the pectoral fin and following the ventral silhouette.
